# LightRAG Storage Options — Technical Report

**Status: PARTIAL**  
The source research run ended `partial_or_incomplete` (5 of 6 steps partial, step 6 blocked). This report is a best-effort synthesis drawn **only** from the supplied evidence (JSON excerpts and source URLs). No external facts were assumed, and nothing here implies the research is complete. Where evidence is missing, that is stated explicitly.

---

## 1. Official documentation and repository

| Item | Finding | Status | Evidence |
|------|---------|--------|----------|
| Official GitHub repository | `https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG` (also reachable as `https://github.com/hkuds/lightrag`; GitHub treats the casing as the same repository) | **supported** | HTML fetch returned HTTP 200; raw README `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HKUDS/LightRAG/main/README.md` returned HTTP 200 with title “LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation” [call-85be80d3-6f8a-44a3-9e7c-5da0d64ce901][call-0d0aca0c-6748-4729-88dd-e0d76bbc763f][call-6b8a5147-97c7-4349-b597-7d5a6239f4e8] |
| Official documentation | In-repo documentation under `docs/`, specifically `https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG/blob/main/docs/LightRAG-API-Server.md`; environment-variable examples in `env.example`; Docker deployment guide in the repo | **partially_supported** | The API-Server URL is referenced and its content is quoted across multiple excerpts (storage selection via env vars, `make env-storage`, recommended storage choices), but that Markdown file was not itself returned with an HTTP 200 in this evidence set [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-29a9f1da-ef45-4030-af94-78a2091bb891][call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b] |
| Separate official docs site (e.g., readthedocs) | Not confirmed | **unsupported** | No standalone documentation host appears in the evidence; docs appear to live only in the GitHub `docs/` folder |

**Verdict:** Repository is verified. Documentation location is identified as in-repo `docs/LightRAG-API-Server.md`, but no separate official documentation site was confirmed.

---

## 2. Supported storage backends

LightRAG requires four storage roles: **key-value (KV)**, **vector**, **graph**, and **document status**. The default, out-of-the-box stores are file-persisted/in-memory and are documented as suitable only for development and debugging, not production.

### Key-value storage
| Backend | Class | Tier / notes | Sources |
|---------|-------|--------------|---------|
| JSON / file | `JsonKVStorage` | Default; small-scale only | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Redis | `RedisKVStorage` | Production option | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| PostgreSQL | `PGKVStorage` | Production option; single DB can serve all four roles | [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-236242ca-998a-4754-800c-cfcb35e4214a] |
| MongoDB | `MongoKVStorage` | Mentioned in env examples | [call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff] |

### Vector storage
| Backend | Class | Tier / notes | Sources |
|---------|-------|--------------|---------|
| Local file | `NanoVectorDBStorage` | Default; small-scale only | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Faiss | `FaissVectorDBStorage` | Production option | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Milvus | `MilvusVectorDBStorage` | Production option; `cuda` choice if NVIDIA GPU + NVIDIA Container Toolkit | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c] |
| Qdrant | `QdrantVectorDBStorage` | Production option | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| PostgreSQL + pgvector | `PGVectorStorage` | Production option; part of unified Postgres backend | [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-236242ca-998a-4754-800c-cfcb35e4214a] |
| MongoDB (Atlas Cloud only) | `MongoVectorDBStorage` | Vector storage only available on Atlas Cloud | [call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-eca9eb2d-b24a-4bfb-82c6-ff47bee8f24d] |
| OpenSearch | — | Requested as a backend option (issue #2682); full-text + vector + JSON; **not confirmed as an implemented LightRAG class** in the official doc excerpts | [call-29a9f1da-ef45-4030-af94-78a2091bb891][call-eca9eb2d-b24a-4bfb-82c6-ff47bee8f24d] |

### Graph storage
| Backend | Class | Tier / notes | Sources |
|---------|-------|--------------|---------|
| NetworkX (file-persisted) | `NetworkXStorage` | Default; small-scale only | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Neo4j | `Neo4JStorage` | Production option | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Memgraph | `MemgraphStorage` | Production option; appears in the API-Server “recommended storage choices” | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3] |
| PostgreSQL + Apache AGE | `PGGraphStorage` / `PGTableGraphStorage` | Production option; see naming conflict below | [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-236242ca-998a-4754-800c-cfcb35e4214a][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b] |
| MongoDB | `MongoGraphStorage` | Mentioned in env examples | [call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff] |

### Document status storage
| Backend | Class | Tier / notes | Sources |
|---------|-------|--------------|---------|
| JSON / file | `JsonDocStatusStorage` | Default; small-scale only | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| Redis | `RedisDocStatusStorage` | Production option | [call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c][call-46e315a1-3817-45a8-a9e9-a01a4d783765] |
| PostgreSQL | `PGDocStatusStorage` | Production option; part of unified Postgres backend | [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-236242ca-998a-4754-800c-cfcb35e4214a] |
| MongoDB | `MongoDocStatusStorage` | Mentioned in env examples | [call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff] |

**Source-link coverage:** Links are captured for the central reference (`LightRAG-API-Server.md`), the Postgres demo (`lightrag_gemini_postgres_demo.py`), issue #2255, the Railway deploy guide, and the DEV.to walkthrough. Not every individual backend class has a unique dedicated source link; several are inferred from the same env-var documentation. → **partially_supported** for “source links captured for each backend.”

---

## 3. Differences between available storage options

| Dimension | Default / file-backed (Json/NanoVectorDB/NetworkX) | Redis | PostgreSQL (unified) | Specialized (Milvus/Qdrant/Faiss; Neo4j/Memgraph) |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------|-------|----------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Persistence | Local file persistence | In-memory / Redis persistence | Durable, ACID (Postgres) | Varies by product |
| Intended scale | Small-scale testing / debugging only | Production | Production; single DB for all four roles | Production; high-scale specialized workloads |
| Extensions required | None | Redis server | `pgvector` (vector) + Apache AGE (graph) | Separate product + client libs |
| Operational complexity | Lowest | Medium | Lowest for unified setup (one DB) | Highest (multiple systems) |
| Evidence-quoted guidance | “explicit … for development and debugging, not production” (Railway) | Production KV/doc-status | Recommended for production with large datasets; can serve all four types on its own | Recommended for vector (Milvus/Qdrant/Faiss) and graph (Neo4j/Memgraph) |

**Key trade-offs captured in evidence:**
- Default file-backed stores are explicitly **not for production** [Railway guide via call-95225fa6-b1a3-4912-bd98-9615f645c1b0].
- PostgreSQL is the simplest production path because one database covers KV, vector (pgvector), graph (Apache AGE), and doc-status — “no Neo4j, Milvus, or Redis to run separately” [Railway guide].
- Specialized stores (Milvus/Qdrant for vector; Neo4j/Memgraph for graph) are offered for cases where a dedicated engine is preferred, at the cost of running additional infrastructure [LightRAG-API-Server.md via call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c; DEV.to via call-125f3740-ef94-496c-8536-23532cc72d8c].
- No benchmark numbers (latency, throughput, ingest rate) are present in the evidence, so performance comparisons are **qualitative only**.

---

## 4. Is PostgreSQL / Neon suitable?

### PostgreSQL — supported and recommended
**Confirmed by multiple sources.** LightRAG provides `PGKVStorage`, `PGVectorStorage`, `PGGraphStorage`/`PGTableGraphStorage`, and `PGDocStatusStorage`, and the documentation recommends PostgreSQL for production deployments with large datasets because it can serve all four storage types on its own [call-95225fa6-b1a3-4912-bd98-9615f645c1b0][call-55a8eb85-9196-4913-bb0a-04354d60ea8c][call-3aa4dcd9-4e89-490e-8240-461f44eab0f8].

The Railway production template runs `ghcr.io/hkuds/lightrag` against a PostgreSQL service built with **pgvector** and **Apache AGE** extensions, pointing all four LightRAG storage roles at Postgres via `LIGHTRAG__STORAGE` variables [call-95225fa6-b1a3-4912-bd98-9615f645c1b0][call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e][call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb].

**Configuration requirements (PostgreSQL):**
- Storage selection: `LIGHTRAG_KV_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_VECTOR_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_GRAPH_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_DOC_STATUS_STORAGE` (e.g., `PGKVStorage`, `PGVectorStorage`, `PGTableGraphStorage`, `PGDocStatusStorage`) [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b].
- Postgres connection: `POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_DATABASE`, plus `POSTGRES_HOST` and `POSTGRES_PORT` [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b]. Example demo values: host `localhost`, port `5432`, user `admin`, password `admin` [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3].
- Extensions: `pgvector` for vector storage; **Apache AGE is required for graph storage** (`PGGraphStorage` relies on AGE) — not plain PostgreSQL [call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e][call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb][call-1a2e4769-1c51-4bc5-a6cf-73af04f6fbf8].
- `make env-storage` is used to configure storage; PostgreSQL/Milvus/Memgraph can be run locally via Docker [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c].

### Neon — not confirmed as a LightRAG backend
The evidence contains general information about Neon (cloud-native PostgreSQL, separated pageserver/safekeeper storage, WAL via safekeepers) [call-43459066-c202-4bc7-8849-ca407255e00d], but **no source states that LightRAG officially supports Neon**, and no LightRAG-specific Neon configuration is documented. Neon is PostgreSQL-compatible, so a connection *might* work, but the evidence does not confirm that the required extensions (especially **Apache AGE** for graph storage) are available on Neon. → **Neon suitability for LightRAG is unverified; do not recommend it for graph storage without confirmation.**

---

## 5. Compatibility limitations and configuration considerations

### Required environment variables (evidence-backed)
| Purpose | Variables | Sources |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| Storage role selection | `LIGHTRAG_KV_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_VECTOR_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_GRAPH_STORAGE`, `LIGHTRAG_DOC_STATUS_STORAGE` | [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b] |
| PostgreSQL connection | `POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_DATABASE`, `POSTGRES_HOST`, `POSTGRES_PORT` | [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b] |
| Neo4j (if used) | `NEO4J_URI`, `NEO4J_USERNAME`, `NEO4J_PASSWORD` | [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c] |

### Gotchas / limitations (evidence-backed)
1. **Graph storage is not plain PostgreSQL.** `PGGraphStorage` depends on the **Apache AGE** extension [call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e][call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb][call-1a2e4769-1c51-4bc5-a6cf-73af04f6fbf8].
2. **Apache AGE version constraint.** AGE is described as compatible with PostgreSQL **up to version 16** and supports ACID transactions [call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e][call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb]. A graph-size limit is mentioned (truncated in evidence: `281474976710655` vertices) [call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb].
3. **LightRAG upgrades can be inefficient / cause long downtimes** (reported in GitHub issue #2255) [call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e][call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb][call-1a2e4769-1c51-4bc5-a6cf-73af04f6fbf8]. Plan maintenance windows and backups before upgrading.
4. **Env vars must be set before the initial launch** of the API server [LightRAG-API-Server.md via call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c].
5. **MongoDB vector storage is Atlas Cloud only** [call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-eca9eb2d-b24a-4bfb-82c6-ff47bee8f24d].
6. **Milvus** deployment notes: choose `cuda` if the host has NVIDIA GPU + NVIDIA Container Toolkit [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c].
7. **Naming inconsistency:** the API-Server example uses `PGTableGraphStorage`, while issue #2255 and other excerpts use `PGGraphStorage`; one source lists both. This may reflect a rename across versions and should be verified against the running LightRAG version [call-ab8b46cd-8b86-400d-98f6-2db025fdd8f2][call-016806a4-edac-4f0b-a745-285e0e812aff][call-042af0fb-1837-4484-a350-6df9aa58598b].

## 6. Recommended production storage architecture (reasoned recommendation)

> This recommendation is **reasoned from the evidence**, not a verbatim architecture published by LightRAG. It should be validated against the LightRAG version you deploy.

### Default recommendation: unified PostgreSQL backend
For a production AI agent, start with **one PostgreSQL instance serving all four LightRAG storage roles**:

- KV: `PGKVStorage`
- Vector: `PGVectorStorage` (requires `pgvector`)
- Graph: `PGTableGraphStorage` / `PGGraphStorage` (requires Apache AGE; verify class name for your version)
- Document status: `PGDocStatusStorage`

Set:
```
LIGHTRAG_KV_STORAGE=PGKVStorage
LIGHTRAG_VECTOR_STORAGE=PGVectorStorage
LIGHTRAG_GRAPH_STORAGE=PGTableGraphStorage   # verify PGGraphStorage vs PGTableGraphStorage
LIGHTRAG_DOC_STATUS_STORAGE=PGDocStatusStorage
POSTGRES_HOST=... POSTGRES_PORT=5432 POSTGRES_USER=... POSTGRES_PASSWORD=... POSTGRES_DATABASE=...
```

**Rationale (evidence-based):**
- Officially recommended for production with large datasets; single DB covers all four roles [call-95225fa6-b1a3-4912-bd98-9615f645c1b0][call-55a8eb85-9196-4913-bb0a-04354d60ea8c].
- Operationally simplest: no separate Neo4j, Milvus, Qdrant, or Redis cluster [Railway guide via call-95225fa6-b1a3-4912-bd98-9615f645c1b0].
- ACID transactions via PostgreSQL/Apache AGE [call-52464c71-2bc8-466b-a311-35f810879bcb].

### When to diverge (hybrid / specialized)
If a single Postgres instance becomes a bottleneck, the evidence supports splitting roles:
- KV + doc-status: Redis (`RedisKVStorage`, `RedisDocStatusStorage`) or keep Postgres.
- Vector: Milvus / Qdrant / Faiss (Milvus needs GPU consideration).
- Graph: Neo4j or Memgraph (dedicated graph engines), instead of PostgreSQL+AGE.

The API-Server’s own “recommended storage choices” example mixes `PGKVStorage` + `PGDocStatusStorage` with `MilvusVectorDBStorage` and `MemgraphStorage`, showing a hybrid pattern is documented [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c][call-16e396f0-4214-4de1-9b69-68311a4752e3]. This increases operational complexity, so adopt only if specific scale or performance requirements justify it.

### Neon
Do **not** select Neon as the graph backend based on current evidence: Apache AGE availability on Neon is unconfirmed. If you want to use Neon for KV/vector/doc-status via `pgvector`, treat it as experimental and verify extension support first.

### Operational guardrails (from evidence)
- Set storage env vars **before first launch**; run `make env-storage`.
- Use Docker Compose for local Postgres (+ Milvus/Memgraph if hybrid) [call-c3d9e4cf-5364-469d-a256-b02f3f0c1d1c].
- Back up before LightRAG upgrades; expect possible long downtimes [issue #2255 via call-2307c180-8010-46f8-869b-98feb306688e].
- Confirm PostgreSQL version supports Apache AGE (evidence: up to v16) before provisioning.
